summary: Ansible 10.0.0 deprecations: inspur.sm and netapp.storagegrid are unmaintained and slated for removal in Ansible 11 unless new maintainers step in.
questions: Is inspur.sm being removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: inspur.sm and netapp.storagegrid deprecations
answer_card.answer_md: `inspur.sm` and `netapp.storagegrid` were marked unmaintained and scheduled for removal in Ansible 11 unless someone resumes maintenance. The storagegrid removal was later cancelled.
